- Remove deprecated telemetry model classes (AITelemetry, AppTelemetry, etc.)

- Add Application Insights skill documentation (.claude/skills/app-insights/)
- Add GitHub Copilot instructions for project context
- Update .gitignore to exclude build/test output files
